name: c-file-type-7
title: Attachment list
description: Attachments with their type, size and a download action.

files.content: import { FileType, getFileType, } from "@/components/reui/file-type" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Item, ItemActions, ItemContent, ItemDescription, ItemGroup, ItemMedia, ItemTitle, } from "@/components/ui/item" import { IconPlaceholder } from "@/app/(create)/components/icon-placeholder" type Attachment = { id: string name: string size: string /** ISO date for the time element, and the short form people read. */ modified: string modifiedLabel: string } const ATTACHMENTS: Attachment[] = [ { id: "agreement", name: "master-services-agreement-signed.pdf", size: "2.1 MB", modified: "2026-10-06", modifiedLabel: "Oct 6", }, { id: "deck", name: "q3-board-deck.pptx", size: "18.4 MB", modified: "2026-10-02", modifiedLabel: "Oct 2", }, { id: "forecast", name: "revenue-forecast-2027.xlsx", size: "860 KB", modified: "2026-09-29", modifiedLabel: "Sep 29", }, { id: "brief", name: "launch-brief.docx", size: "312 KB", modified: "2026-09-24", modifiedLabel: "Sep 24", }, { id: "demo", name: "product-demo.mp4", size: "64.2 MB", modified: "2026-09-18", modifiedLabel: "Sep 18", }, ] export function Pattern() { return ( {ATTACHMENTS.map((file) => ( // ItemGroup is a role="list", so each row declares itself a listitem // or assistive tech announces an empty list. {/* * The light page keeps its shape against the row border, where an * outline page would read as a second frame. aria-hidden because * the visible name already ends in the extension. */} {/* * min-w-0 lets the content shrink below the name's width, and the * span (not the flex title) carries the ellipsis. */} {file.name} {file.size} {file.modifiedLabel} ))} ) }
